issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI: six RefsPanel Highlights-key/tab-restore XCTests fail on every master run since 1311536
issue.description:
## CI failure

bob-mac-capture's macOS CI Test step has failed on every master run since 1311536 "feat(refs): ephemeral Highlights-key session on focused page" (agent 14b, 2026-10-25 15:24 EDT, no epic). The last green run was 40195734261 at 461f46c. The same six RefsPanel tests fail in runs 40225855522 (1311536), 40334595958 (7b9bbdd), 40354939648 (672ee8a), and 40358201800 (d8a828f), except testHighlightsKeySelectsCurrentTab, which passed in the d8a828f run. Assertions at d8a828f (run 40358201800):

- RefsPanelDesignTests.testRefsPanelStatesToPNG: RefsPanelDesignTests.swift:1901 "ref/chat/today_report.md" != "ref/chat/morning_notes.md"; :2080 XCTAssertNotEqual both "ref/chat/today_report.md".
- RefsPanelModelTests.testHighlightsTabsShowResetsAndLibraryRestoresTheFilter: :3060 XCTAssertTrue; :3065 nil != 90.0; :3086 nil != "ref/chat/small_reading.md"; :3087 nil != 90.0.
- RefsPanelModelTests.testHighlightsKeyFocusPublishesAndReveals: :3151 XCTUnwrap RefsInspectorFocus nil; :5651 model condition timeout.
- RefsPanelModelTests.testHighlightsKeyFocusReselectionRearmsAndCtrlDCancels: :3238 XCTAssertNotNil; :5651 timeout.
- RefsPanelModelTests.testTabSwitchUsesTheSwitcherPreselectionOnceOnTheNextShow: :4004 "ref/blogs/small_opened.md" != "ref/books/small_book.md"; :4005/:4012 "ref/chat/small_reading.md" != "ref/blogs/small_opened.md"; :5651 timeout.
- RefsPanelModelTests.testHighlightsKeySelectsCurrentTab: failed at 1311536, 7b9bbdd, and 672ee8a.

The pattern is selection and restore state (the restored selection, a 90.0 scroll offset, the inspector focus), which the Highlights-key session in 1311536 now changes on focus. Decide per test whether the product regressed or the expectation predates the intended Highlights-key behavior. Do not weaken assertions without that evidence. Closed bob-cli-8j and bob-cli-ag covered earlier, different failures of some of these suites.

Not included: RefsPanelModelTests.testHighlightsCopyShowStashesAndLibraryRestoresTheFilter has failed since it was added by cc.7 (7b9bbdd). It is recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE on active epic bob-cli-cc.

Found by the batch-13 lander (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.land) during the backlog audit. Phase refs-refresh-flake (.4) first saw the red job at 7b9bbdd ("18 failures outside RefsLibraryTests").

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same assertions fail in all four master runs from 1311536 through d8a828f (40225855522, 40334595958, 40354939648, 40358201800); the run before 1311536 (461f46c) was green; failures are value mismatches, not only timeouts.

issue.creation_reason: Mac CI on master has been deterministically red for four consecutive runs since the ephemeral Highlights-key session commit, and no bead tracks it; it hides new regressions.
